gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Bellota's s has terminals that swing wide of its body, and every stroke is traced like one stylus line. Encode Sans Expanded takes over below with c shapes whose tips pull well apart, approachable and easy on a paragraph.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-sc: Every stroke in Bellota is traced at the width of a single stylus, with an s whose ends hang loose and wide. Encode Sans SC is the plain sans for steady text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-semi-conde: Bellota draws an s with its ends hung wide, and not a hint of calligraphic modulation anywhere in the line. Encode Sans Semi Condensed handles the quieter work, its open counter on the s making ordinary text feel modern and approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-semi-expan: Bellota is distinctive and commanding, with every stroke drawn at one weight and an s that swings its ends wide. Encode Sans Semi Expanded settles beneath it, rounded and left open.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-exo: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota has strokes with no hairlines and no shadows, plus an s that hangs its ends wide. Exo follows it with wide gaps that keep text crisp, so a long paragraph feels approachable and clean.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-fahkwang: Commanding and a bit odd, Bellota draws each stroke like toothpaste squeezed in a steady line. Big and short is where it lands best, while Fahkwang adds a faint nib-pressure variation you only catch up close.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-finlandica: Finlandica brings e crossbars with open mouths and an outline you could trace with a finger. Bellota above it adds a wide-hanging s, and the text below keeps a contemporary, clean feel from line to line.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gothic-a1: No difference between stems and connecting strokes: that is the most telling thing about Bellota, along with its wide-hanging s. Yet Gothic A1 brings a splayed c terminal below, so the headline's quirks sit over text that feels approachable and professional.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gotu: Bellota's s throws its ends wide, and each stroke is traced as one steady line, a soft hum across the paragraph. But Gotu gives a longer stretch of text a gentle weight change where its bowls curve around.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-gowun-dodum: Bellota is the commanding one, its s hanging wide and every stroke traced at one stylus width. Gowun Dodum does the quieter job, a wide mouth in the lowercase a and a smooth tube-like look to each line.
